verdict.rationale: BVNK is a stablecoin payments platform, so support for machine-payment protocols is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence names x402, ACP, MPP or AP2, or documents endpoints or SDKs for any of them. The docs cover only general payment APIs, webhooks and Hawk auth, and the agent-wallet-cli probe names no protocol, so it is at most adjacent and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, the platform speaks the machine-payment protocols by name — x402, ACP, MPP, or AP2 support documented with endpoints or SDKs, not just a blog aspiration
